research_scope: New controllable video and animation capability demos; verified primary sources, not an unverified daily popularity ranking.

rounds.title_zh: 脚掌落地不打滑：支撑相接触锁定与步态逆运动学选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Grounded steps without foot skating: stance-contact locking and gait IK FAQ
conclusions_zh: 滑步源于在根骨骼局部空间摆腿而髋部在世界空间匀速推进，两者速度在支撑相无法抵消。
支撑相把脚踝锁死在世界地面锚点并反求 1.45/1.35 双连杆 IK，81 个采样帧保持零滑移（1.78e-15 u 对比未锁基线 0.2452 u）。
65 实体双足桁架核验确定性接触约束与 Node CPU 求解，不冒充 StepControl 或 ARDY 神经扩散推理。
conclusions_en: Foot skating occurs when legs swing in hip-local space while the hip translates uniformly in world space.
Pinning stance ankles to world ground anchors and solving 1.45/1.35 two-link IK retains zero slip across 81 frames (1.78e-15 u vs 0.2452 u unpinned).
The 65-solid bipedal rig verifies deterministic contact locking and Node CPU solving without claiming StepControl or ARDY diffusion execution.

rounds.title_zh: 高速旋转不飞出切线：亚帧快门圆弧积分与线性速度涂抹选型 FAQ
rounds.title_en: Curved motion without tangent spikes: sub-frame shutter integration vs linear velocity blur FAQ
conclusions_zh: 单帧瞬时速度向量只记录切线方向，270° 快门下线性涂抹向叶轮外缘飞出 0.0854 示意单位。
快门窗内 9 个亚帧时刻沿圆弧采样严格守恒半径 R=2.2（61 帧最大径向误差 8.88e-16 u）。
64 实体斩波轮对比递推相量与逐抽头三角函数（24.28 ms vs 42.74 ms），不冒充 MoBGS 或 SplineGS 神经去模糊。
conclusions_en: Instantaneous velocity vectors capture only the tangent direction, overshooting the rotor rim by 0.0854 units at 270° shutter.
Sampling 9 sub-frame taps along the curved trajectory preserves exact R=2.2 across 61 frames (max error 8.88e-16 u).
The 64-solid chopper compares incremental phasor stepping against per-tap trig (24.28 ms vs 42.74 ms) without claiming MoBGS or SplineGS inference.
